name: Undertaking Amendment Advice V 01
definition: The UndertakingAmendmentAdvice message is sent by an advising party to the beneficiary, either directly or via one or more other advising parties in the transaction chain, to advise the content of a proposed amendment to an undertaking. Information about the message may also be sent to other interested parties. The proposed undertaking amendment could be to a demand guarantee, standby letter of credit, or counter-undertaking (counter-guarantee or counter-standby). In addition to providing the terms of the proposed amendment and relevant details on proposed changes to the undertaking, the message may provide information from the sender such as confirmation details. It may also be used to advise the proposed termination or cancellation of the undertaking.

AdvisingParty.name: Advising Party
AdvisingParty.definition: Party advising the undertaking to the beneficiary or to another party.

SecondAdvisingParty.name: Second Advising Party
SecondAdvisingParty.definition: Additional party that advises the undertaking.

DateOfAdvice.name: Date Of Advice
DateOfAdvice.definition: Date on which the undertaking is advised.

UndertakingAmendmentAdviceDetails.name: Undertaking Amendment Advice Details
UndertakingAmendmentAdviceDetails.definition: Details related to the advice of the proposed amended undertaking.

BankToBankInformation.name: Bank To Bank Information
BankToBankInformation.definition: Additional information specific to the bank-to-bank communication.

DigitalSignature.name: Digital Signature
DigitalSignature.definition: Digital signature of the proposed amendment advice.
